description: Extract OCR text from screenshots, documents, tables, terminal output, or code images.

file_id.description: file_id returned by PUT /upload. Preferred over image_base64 to avoid corruption of large base64 in the tool-call path. Persistent across restarts, content-deduplicated.

image_base64.description: Raw base64-encoded image bytes, without a data: URL prefix. Prefer file_id for large images.

mime_type.description: MIME type. Required with image_base64; ignored (uses stored value) with file_id.

name: extract_text_from_image
